facts.fact: At the 8 July 2026 workshop validating the e-Santé roadmap 2025-2029, the national interoperability layer was demonstrated and its presenter said it is already operational with several systems, with Estelab disease-surveillance data now transferred automatically into DHIS2 without manual weekly entry at health centres, districts and hospitals.

systems.owner: Direction de la e-Santé, Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène publique

note: Only two systems (Estelab, DHIS2) are named as exchanging; 'plusieurs systèmes' is not a count of three, so no breadth fact.
